brief.zh: 标出主干，把修饰成分折起来，挂到它修饰的词上。
brief.en: Mark the skeleton and fold the modifier onto the word it modifies.

t.zh: 介词短语也会放在句首，用逗号和主干隔开。
t.en: A prepositional phrase can also open the sentence, set off from the skeleton by a comma.

hint.zh: “在这篇论文里”说明的是哪件事？
hint.en: What is it that happens “in this paper”?

sentence: In this paper, we propose a new attention mechanism.

mechanism.zh: 句首带逗号的介词短语说的是整件事在哪里发生：“在这篇论文里，我们提出……”。它和 mechanism 之间隔着整个主干。
mechanism.en: A phrase up front with a comma says where the whole thing happens: in this paper, we propose. The whole skeleton stands between it and mechanism.

title.zh: In this paper, we propose a new attention mechanism.
title.en: In this paper, we propose a new attention mechanism.

body.zh: 句首的 In this paper 挂在谓语 propose 上，管的是整件事。论文里大量句子都这样开头：In this section、In contrast、In practice。
body.en: The opening In this paper hangs on the verb propose, covering the whole event. Countless sentences in papers open like this: In this section, In contrast, In practice.

note.zh: 句首、带逗号的介词短语，通常挂在谓语上。
note.en: A phrase up front with a comma usually hangs on the verb.
